howto: Press Play to start at your next level, or Choose level for the map of 20 levels in 4 worlds.
Drag anywhere to slide the paddle, and tap to launch the ball.
Break every brick; catch the falling capsules for multi-ball, wide paddle, laser, slow ball, fireball or an extra life.
Keep all three balls for three stars, and spend gems on new ball and paddle sets.
tips: Where the ball hits the paddle sets its angle: the edges send it sideways.
Silver rims take two hits, gold rims three, steel never breaks, and a bomb brick hurts its neighbours.
Breaking bricks without touching the paddle builds a combo worth up to 8x points.
Fireball smashes straight through bricks; lasers hit anything above the paddle.
If a level beats you twice the paddle gets wider and the ball slower to help.

controls.keyboard: Left and Right (or A and D) move the paddle, Space or Enter launches. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Drag anywhere to slide the paddle, tap to launch

difficulty: An adaptive curve: 20 hand-made levels get harder step by step, the ball speeds up a little each level, and failing the same level twice makes the paddle wider and the ball slower. Three stars for clearing a level without losing a ball.

cheats.effect: Floor shield: the ball bounces off the bottom, so you never lose one
Big paddle: the wide paddle all the time
Multi-ball: every serve launches three balls

features.difficulty: Adaptive: harder levels and ball speed, with a helping hand after two fails; stars measure skill
features.power-up-list: Six power-up capsules: 3 multi-ball, W wide, L laser, S slow, F fire, heart extra life; the how-to lists them
features.wave-or-level-counter: LEVEL n and the world name at the top, plus a map of 20 levels with stars
features.high-score-table: Top 5 runs on the result card and a star count per level on the map
features.results: Result card with stars, points, top-5 runs, gems earned, today's goals and the next set to unlock
features.progression: 20 levels in 4 worlds with 3 stars each, eight ball and paddle sets, daily goals with a star challenge, week stamps with a weekly gift
features.daily-goals: Three goals and one star challenge a day
